## F2 -- gated contrast in the body with its power cost
- `roughly a halving` found in: Multiple-Comparison Correction
  > What changes is power: gating discards every run without a valid alarm, so the mean effective sample size per detector falls from 3.0 to 1.3 on XJTUSY, 4.8 to 2.8 on FEMTO, 5.0 to 3.6 on Ferrara and 2.7 to 1.2 on IMS, roughly a halving.
